t: This is the former New End Hospital in Hampstead, now redeveloped as housing. It began in 1869 as the infirmary of the Hampstead Union workhouse and operated until 1986. Two people died here. Leslie Hutchinson, known as Hutch, was born in Grenada and was one of the biggest cabaret stars in the world during the 1920s and 1930s. Doris Dunn was a British anthropologist and archaeologist.
